Show available parsers

Source: R/utils.R
pb_available.Rd

Show available parsers

Usage

pb_available(...)

Arguments

...

optionally pass URLs to check if respective parser(s) is/are available.

Value

A character vector of supported domains.

Examples

pb_available()
#>   [1] "3sat.de"                        "abendblatt.de"                 
#>   [3] "abendzeitung.muenchen.de"       "abs.cbn.com"
